title: MOCLIP: A Foundation Model for Large-Scale Nanophotonic Inverse Design
abstract: arXiv:2511.18980v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models (FM) are transforming artificial intelligence by enabling generalizable, data-efficient solutions across different domains for a broad range of applications. However, the lack of large and diverse datasets limits the development of FM in nanophotonics. This work presents MOCLIP (Metasurface Optics Contrastive Learning Pretrained), a nanophotonic foundation model that integrates metasurface geometry and spectra within a shared latent space. MOCLIP employs contrastive learning to align geometry and spectral representations using an experimentally acquired dataset with a sample density comparable to ImageNet-1K. The study demonstrates MOCLIP inverse design capabilities for high-throughput zero-shot prediction at a rate of 0.2 million samples per second, enabling the design of a full 4-inch wafer populated with high-density metasurfaces in minutes. translated_title: MOCLIP：大规模纳米光子逆向设计的基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2511.18980v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：基础模型（FM）通过实现跨不同领域的通用化、数据高效的解决方案，正在变革人工智能，适用于广泛的应用。然而，大型和多样化数据集的缺乏限制了FM在纳米光子学中的发展。本工作提出了MOCLIP（超表面光学对比学习预训练），一种纳米光子基础模型，将超表面几何和光谱集成在一个共享的潜在空间中。MOCLIP采用对比学习，利用一个样本密度与ImageNet-1K相当的实验获取数据集，对齐几何和光谱表示。该研究展示了MOCLIP在每秒20万样本速率下的高通量零样本预测逆向设计能力，使能在几分钟内设计一个布满高密度超表面的完整4英寸晶圆。它还展示了生成式潜在空间优化，达到97%的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出MOCLIP，一种结合几何与光谱的纳米光子基础模型，通过对比学习实现高速零样本逆向设计，可在几分钟内完成4英寸晶圆的高密度超表面设计。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MOCLIP, a nanophotonic foundation model integrating geometry and spectra via contrastive learning, enabling high-throughput zero-shot inverse design for full 4-inch wafers in minutes.
